title: Uniform regular Taylor stratum and its straightened extension
statement:
Let k be a characteristic-zero field, U a smooth affine finite-type k-scheme and i:X->U a closed immersion with coherent ideal, a in X [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-weil-closed-immersion] [pqf-def-coherent]. Let j:N->U be smooth closed over k with b0 in N and j(b0)=i(a). Fix etale coordinates coord=(w,z) on U over k and etale restricted coordinates w on N [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Fix regular coordinate derivations der annihilating k and with der_l(coord_r)=delta_lr [def-trf-formal-power-series-partial-derivative]. Let TU_y and TN_b be the centered residue-field-valued Taylor maps, and straight_b a ring homomorphism with the same scalar and residue values, sending w_l to w_l(b)+W_l and z_l to rename(TN_b(j^*z_l))+Z_l [def-weil-residue-field] [def-trf-regular-hilbert-coefficient-datum]. Set K_b=map(straight_b)(ker i^*). Let D be monotone with ordered minimal vertices (0,alpha_i), with exactly the essential transverse variables [def-trf-formal-initial-diagram] [def-trf-supported-homogeneous-division]. Suppose f_{i,b} belongs to K_b for every b. At b0 assume order(f_i)=|alpha_i|, homogeneous division for every degree prefix, supported generation of K_b0, and initial diagram D after renaming Fin m+Fin n to Fin(m+n). Fix Q>=|alpha_i|-1. At every b and each occurring degree d, assume the vertex-derivative block and unit-Jacobian hypotheses and the later-generator restricted-diagram derivative conditions through Q as in [lem-trf-formal-hilbert-stratum-minors]. There is q0>=|alpha_i|-1 independent of a finite regular generating list of ker i^*, such that for every q>=q0 and every such list generators, there exists an open V containing i(a) on which, writing J_q for its cumulative regular Taylor-rank minor ideal through q [def-trf-taylor-rank-minor-ideals],
J_q is contained in ker(ev_y) iff extendedHilbert(map(TU_y)(ker i^*))(t)=hilbertCount(D,t) for every t,
and map(straight_b0)(J_q)=lowDerivativeIdeal(alpha,f_b0).
No coefficient expansion or coefficient-order conditions are assumed.

source.place: BM 1997 Theorem 7.14, Remarks 9.1 and 9.5, completion of Theorem 9.6, pp.265--268,275--277,282. Returned step 11. ILO VIII 2.3.11--2.3.13 is the route reference; BM is read online, absent locally. No single Stacks tag states this result.

proof.text: Supported division and the initial-diagram identity identify the central Hilbert function with hilbertCount(D). Apply [lem-trf-jet-diagram-hilbert-control] to the coherent ideal on the affine chart: its Taylor diagrams, and therefore its Hilbert functions, take finitely many local values. For one finite regular generating list, apply the equality-germ clause of [lem-trf-formal-hilbert-stratum-minors] to a cutoff distinguishing the central function from all these other functions. Enlarge that cutoff to at least all vertex degrees minus one.

Translation followed by truncation is multiplicative; two generating lists give the same truncated translated submodule. For positive central quotient dimension identify its rank-minor ideal with the corresponding presentation Fitting ideal and apply [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change]. For zero central quotient dimension both rank-minor ideals are zero by oversizing. Thus the individual regular minors, and the cutoff chosen with one generating list, work for every list.

The straight map has the triangular coordinate change fixing W and adding the restricted Taylor series to Z; [lem-trf-implicit-taylor-coordinate-calculus] identifies it with the invertible straightening of the usual Taylor map. On each truncated translation module substitute F(X+Y)-F(X) in Y; its inverse comes from F inverse. The substitution is linear over the ambient Taylor ring and preserves the presented quotient. Fitting invariance, the regular-to-formal Taylor-minor identity and formal generator independence identify map(straight)(J_q) with formalStratumIdeal(f_b0,q). Ordered minimal vertices imply the degree order and incomparability needed by the formal stratum theorem. Apply it with the given central supported generation and block derivative hypotheses to obtain lowDerivativeIdeal. The natural bound d_i-1 implies the corresponding integer bound, including d_i=0.

theorem straightened_regular_stratum_comparison
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    (U X N : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine U]
    (p : U ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [Smooth p] [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p]
    (i : X ⟶ U) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hcoherent : RingedSpace.IsCoherent U.toRingedSpace i.ker.toModules)
    (a : X) (j : N ⟶ U) [IsClosedImmersion j] [Smooth (j ≫ p)]
    (b₀ : N) (hb₀ : j b₀ = i a) {m n s : ℕ}
    (coord : MvPolynomial (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) k →+* Γ(U, ⊤))
    (hetale : Etale (U.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom coord)))
    (hover : U.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coord.comp MvPolynomial.C)) = p)
    (w : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k →+* Γ(N, ⊤))
    (hw : w = j.appTop.hom.comp (coord.comp (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl).toRingHom))
    (hetaleW : Etale (N.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom w)))
    (der : (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) → Derivation ℤ Γ(U, ⊤) Γ(U, ⊤))
    (hderk : ∀ (l : Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (r : k), der l (coord (MvPolynomial.C r)) = 0)
    (hderx : ∀ l r : Fin m ⊕ Fin n,
      der l (coord (MvPolynomial.X r)) = if l = r then 1 else 0)
    (TU : ∀ y : U, Γ(U, ⊤) →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (U.residueField y))
    (hTU : ∀ y : U, isTaylorMap coord (U.Γevaluation y).hom (TU y))
    (TN : ∀ b : N, Γ(N, ⊤) →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin m) (N.residueField b))
    (hTN : ∀ b : N, isTaylorMap w (N.Γevaluation b).hom (TN b))
    (straight : ∀ b : N, Γ(U, ⊤) →+*
      MvPowerSeries (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (N.residueField b))
    (hres : ∀ (b : N) (r : Γ(U, ⊤)),
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (straight b r) = N.Γevaluation b (j.appTop r))
    (hk : ∀ (b : N) (r : k), straight b (coord (MvPolynomial.C r)) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (N.Γevaluation b (j.appTop (coord (MvPolynomial.C r)))))
    (hW : ∀ (b : N) (l : Fin m), straight b (coord (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl l))) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (N.Γevaluation b (w (MvPolynomial.X l))) +
        MvPowerSeries.X (Sum.inl l))
    (hZ : ∀ (b : N) (l : Fin n), straight b (coord (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr l))) =
      MvPowerSeries.rename Sum.inl (TN b (j.appTop (coord (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr l))))) +
        MvPowerSeries.X (Sum.inr l))
    (α : Fin s → Fin n →₀ ℕ) (D : Set (Fin (m + n) →₀ ℕ))
    (hmonotone : MonomialDiagram.IsMonotone D)
    (hvertices : MonomialDiagram.IsOrderedVertexFamily D
      (fun l ↦ Finsupp.mapDomain finSumFinEquiv (fullVertex m (α l))))
    (hessential : ∀ l : Fin n, ∃ v : Fin s, 0 < α v l)
    (f : ∀ b : N, Fin s → MvPowerSeries (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (N.residueField b))
    (hmember : ∀ (b : N) (l : Fin s),
      f b l ∈ taylorIdeal (RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom) (straight b))
    (horder : ∀ l : Fin s, (f b₀ l).order = ((α l).degree : ℕ∞))
    (hdivision : homogeneousDivision α (f b₀))
    (hgeneration : ∀ h ∈ taylorIdeal (RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom) (straight b₀),
      ∃ g : Fin s → MvPowerSeries (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (N.residueField b₀),
        h = ∑ l : Fin s, g l * f b₀ l ∧
          ∀ l : Fin s, supported (g l) (inDelta (fun v ↦ fullVertex m (α v)) l))
    (hinitial : MonomialDiagram.initialDiagram
      (Ideal.map (MvPowerSeries.renameEquiv (N.residueField b₀) finSumFinEquiv).toRingHom
        (taylorIdeal (RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom) (straight b₀))) = D)
    (Q : ℕ) (hQ : ∀ l : Fin s, (α l).degree - 1 ≤ Q)
    (hblocks : ∀ (b : N) (d : ℕ), (∃ l : Fin s, (α l).degree = d) →
      ∃ (pick : {l : Fin n // essential α d l} → Fin s)
        (β : {l : Fin n // essential α d l} → Fin n →₀ ℕ),
        (∀ l, α (pick l) = β l + Finsupp.single l.val 1 ∧
          (α (pick l)).degree ≤ d ∧
          iteratedPartial (fullVertex m (β l)) (f b (pick l)) ∈ transverseIdeal α d) ∧
        IsUnit (Matrix.det (fun l r : {l : Fin n // essential α d l} ↦
          MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (MvPowerSeries.pderiv (N.residueField b) (Sum.inr r.val)
            (iteratedPartial (fullVertex m (β l)) (f b (pick l)))))))
    (hlater : ∀ (b : N) (d : ℕ), (∃ l : Fin s, (α l).degree = d) →
      ∀ l : Fin s, d < (α l).degree → ∀ δ : Fin n →₀ ℕ,
        δ.degree ≤ Q → (∀ r : Fin n, δ r ≠ 0 → essential α d r) →
        inDiagram α d δ → iteratedPartial (fullVertex m δ) (f b l) ∈ transverseIdeal α d) :
    ∃ q₀ : ℕ, (∀ l : Fin s, (α l).degree - 1 ≤ q₀) ∧
      ∀ q : ℕ, q₀ ≤ q → ∀ (r : ℕ) (generators : Fin r → Γ(U, ⊤)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range generators) = RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom →
        ∃ V : U.Opens, i a ∈ V ∧
          (∀ y : U, y ∈ V →
            ((⨆ t ∈ Finset.range (q + 1),
              regularJetMinorIdeal coord der generators (U.Γevaluation (i a)).hom t) ≤
                RingHom.ker (U.Γevaluation y).hom ↔
              ∀ t : ℕ, extendedHilbert
                (taylorIdeal (RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom) (TU y)) t =
                  (MonomialDiagram.hilbertCount D t : ℕ∞))) ∧
          Ideal.map (straight b₀)
            (⨆ t ∈ Finset.range (q + 1),
              regularJetMinorIdeal coord der generators (U.Γevaluation (i a)).hom t) =
            lowDerivativeIdeal α (f b₀)
